findings_qualitative.value: SMM11 has no 70 um or shorter-wavelength counterpart and drives a collimated outflow

evidence.quote: SMM11 is a Class 0 protostar without any counterpart at 70 $\mu$m or shorter wavelengths.

claims.hypothesis: SMM11 is an extremely young protostar
claims.experiment: ALMA 1.3 mm, 12CO, C18O plus Spitzer/Herschel SED
claims.result: Tbol 26 K, Lint<=0.043 Lsun, low C18O abundance, spherical envelope

evidence.quote: The low $L_{\rm int}$, $T_{\rm bol}$, $X$(C$^{18}$O) values and spherical envelope of SMM11 are consistent with theoretical predictions of the FHSC phase.

claims.result: v0~4 km/s/arcsec, few 10 km/s at few 1000 AU
claims.finding: Too fast for FHSC; SMM11 is a transitional object after second collapse

evidence.quote: we suggest that SMM11 is a transitional object right after the second collapse of the first core.
